_comment: Durable Amazon ASIN registry, keyed by card_id. build_site.py merges these into pricing.amazon_asin at build time so they survive aggregator rebuilds (which regenerate data/cards/*.json without ASINs). Each ASIN verified live against amazon.com before entry. When a card's ASIN changes, update HERE, not in the card JSON (that gets overwritten).
